evidence.clarity: 1440 and 390: H1 'Wake to thirty minutes of sunrise. One dial, no app.' plus lede 'Morrow is a bedside lamp. Turn the dial to the time you want to be up...' says what it is and how it works in two lines; the CTA 'Reserve a Morrow' with '$20 deposit, refunded whenever you ask. Checkout isn't connected yet, so no card today.' directly under it states the next step. Nothing later contradicts it.
evidence.fit: Every brief constraint has a visible answer: the artifact is a drawn bedroom scene labelled 'Drawing of the prototype; not a photo' and 'Drawn, not measured'; the deposit is stated as not payable today ('no card today', and at #reserve 'Checkout isn't connected yet, so this opens an email to us... take nothing today'); ship timing stays 'planned for next autumn; we will name a date when we can keep it'; a 'Settled / Still changing' list handles the CAD-will-change tension; 'You will find no sleep-science claims on this page'. The reservation is a mailto to a placeholder address the brief did not name, which is the one soft spot.
evidence.distinctiveness: Section backgrounds walk night (#0f1321) -> dawn brown -> sand -> morning cream, so scrolling is itself a sunrise; the hero scene keeps the window dark ('Outside the window: still night. The light is all Morrow's'), which is a product-specific idea; the CAD-style line drawing with numbered callouts and 'width: not final' dimension line is specific. The structure is still a familiar split hero / steps / FAQ, and the end state of the scene is a flat beige room rather than a memorable moment.
evidence.proof: 1440: the operable sunrise (scene, 144px dial, readout '-18 min Deep orange, like a candle across the room', play button) sits in the first viewport beside the headline. I dragged the dial to the top-right (0 min, 'Full brightness. This is the time you set.'), played the 30 minutes (labelled 'Runs the whole rise in fifteen seconds'), paused at -19 min, resumed, and it ended on 'Play it again'. Labelled as drawn, not measured. Weakness: at 0 min the lamp diffuser renders as a greyish beige blob in a beige room (1440 screenshot after End key), so the brightest moment reads less like light than the -18 state.
evidence.craft: Deliberate type pairing (serif display, sans text, mono readout), clamp-based scale, tokenised spacing, 44px+ buttons. Defects: the <figure> elements keep the browser default 40px side margin, so the hero card ends at x=1287 while the header CTA ends at 1328 at 1440, and at 390 the artifact card is only ~276px wide (x 57-333) inside a 358px column, which squeezes the readout to 'Nearly full, / still warm.' and 'Runs the whole rise in / fifteen seconds.'; the prototype drawing card is inset the same way.
evidence.mobile: 390: H1, lede, 'Reserve a Morrow' (181x54) and the deposit disclosure are all in the first 844px; the artifact begins at ~y=610 so only the top of the scene peeks in. Menu button 71x46 opens a panel of 47px-tall links, Escape closes it, tapping 'Price and deposit' closes it and lands on #reserve. Header CTA hidden under 560px so the hero CTA carries it. Slider tap at 80% gave '-5 min Nearly full, still warm.' with the scene updating directly above. No overflow at 390 or 320. The 40px figure inset makes the artifact cramped.
evidence.honesty: Every disclosure sits next to the thing it qualifies: 'no card today' under the hero CTA, 'this opens an email to us... take nothing today' directly under the final 'Reserve a Morrow' mailto button, 'Drawing of the prototype; not a photo' on the scene, 'Drawn, not measured' under the controls, 'width: not final' on the drawing. Ship date stays 'next autumn' as the brief says. No invented proof. The caution is confident ('That is the whole idea') rather than apologetic.
evidence.interaction: Operated at 1440, 768 and 390: dial drag (pointer capture, clamps at both ends; a drag into the bottom dead zone settled at -30), range slider by tap and keyboard (Home -> '-30 min Off...', ArrowRight x2 -> '-28 min', End -> '0 min Full brightness'), play -> 'Pause the sunrise' with note 'Playing: thirty minutes in fifteen seconds.', pause -> 'Resume the sunrise' / 'Paused at -19 min.', end -> 'Play it again' / 'Full brightness. Turn the dial to go back.' Phase text is aria-live. FAQ details open. No console errors. The visual dial is aria-hidden and not focusable (the range input carries keyboard), and the final reserve is a mailto rather than an in-page confirmation.
evidence.copy: Specific and written: 'Ten o'clock on a Sunday or six on a Monday; it is one turn either way. That sentence is the manual.', 'Weighted so a sleepy hand turning the dial doesn't drag the lamp with it.', phase lines like 'Amber. The room has edges again.' Button labels say what happens ('Play the thirty minutes', 'Pause the sunrise'). Some repetition: 'no app, no screen' appears in the H1, lede, how-it-works, Settled list, FAQ and footer.
evidence.first_screen: 1440: specific outcome (thirty minutes of sunrise, one dial), an operable illustration of it, and 'Reserve a Morrow' with the no-charge note, all in 900px. 390: promise, action and disclosure are in view but the artifact is mostly below the fold, so the believability element is only hinted at on the phone.

problems: Default <figure> margins inset the hero artifact and the prototype drawing by 40px each side, misaligning them with the grid at 1440 and cramping the artifact to ~276px at 390.
The scene's end state (0 min, full brightness) renders the lamp as a dull grey-beige shape in a flat beige room, so the payoff of the demo looks weaker than the mid-rise states.

At 390 the artifact starts around y=610, so the phone first screen shows the promise and action but not the light itself; reservation ends in a mailto to an address the brief did not supply (a .example placeholder).

evidence.clarity: H1 'A lamp that wakes you the way a window does.' is a metaphor: it names a lamp but not the rising-light mechanism; the lede ('Thirty minutes before you want to be up, Morrow starts to glow...') and 'No app. No screen. One dial.' make it clear one line later. At 390 the lede and CTA fall below the artifact, so the first screen shows only the metaphor plus the scene.
evidence.fit: Tone is right and the artifact answers 'let them get a feel for the light'. But the brief's constraint that nothing can be collected or paid today is resolved with a form that claims to hold a place while sending nothing (HOLD_ENDPOINT is empty; the address goes only to localStorage). The page also adds commitments the brief did not make: 'Planned for autumn 2027', automatic refunds 'if the first batch slips by more than a season', a press-to-toggle reading-lamp mode, an optional chime being tested, and a Charlotte prototype 'since spring'.
evidence.distinctiveness: The strongest art direction of the two: the ramp section is a full-bleed dusk-to-paper gradient with the minute list rendered as colour bands (0/5/15/25/30 min), the page shifts from night to 'morning' paper, the dial has an amber progress arc and the readout is a real clock (6:30 -> 7:00), and the sunrise autoplays once on load. Charter serif throughout gives a quiet editorial voice. Below the ramp it falls back to a conventional two-column honest/plan/FAQ stack.
evidence.proof: 1440: the sunrise plays automatically ~600ms after load; I watched it go from 6:30 'Thirty minutes to go. The room is dark.' to 7:00 'Full light, a warm white. Nothing rang.' with a convincing warm-white glowing shade and halo. Caption 'Drawn, not photographed...' sits directly under the scene. This is the better-looking payoff of the two scenes. The 'window' of the headline is not in the drawing.
evidence.craft: Good palette and gradient work, clean serif hierarchy. Defects: at 1440 the 'One dial' section and the reserve section leave the right half of the page empty; the hint wraps to a lone 'up.' ('...before a 7:00 wake- / up.'); at 390 the price line orphans 'open'; header links are 25-26px tall; the @media (max-width:30rem) dial size override is beaten by the later .dial rule (dial stays 152px at 390); the 'Pause' button is 38px tall.
evidence.mobile: 390: the hero is recomposed title -> scene -> dial -> copy, which puts the artifact in the first screen (good) but pushes 'Reserve a place' to y=1028 and 'See how it works' to y=1093, below the 844px viewport. There is no menu; three inline text links are 25px tall, and at 320 they wrap to two lines ('How it / works', 'The / plan'). No horizontal overflow. Form error and confirmation appear in place near the button.
evidence.honesty: Drawings are labelled and the hero note says 'Deposits aren't open yet; you can hold a place with your email today.' But submitting test@example.com shows 'Your place is held. We've noted test@example.com. You'll get one email when the $20 deposit opens...' while nothing leaves the browser (script: HOLD_ENDPOINT = ''; only localStorage.setItem). The page also states unsupported facts as fact: 'It sits on a nightstand in Charlotte and has woken one of us every morning since spring', 'Questions we've been asked', and pins the batch to 'autumn 2027' against the brief's wish not to promise a date.
evidence.interaction: Dial is a proper role=slider: Home -> 6:30, PageUp -> 6:35, End -> 7:00, arrows step a minute, wheel works, drag clamps (dead-zone drag snapped to 7:00). Play -> 'Pause' -> 'Play the sunrise' (resumes from the current value) -> 'Play it again'. Autoplay stops when the dial is touched. Form: empty and 'not-an-email' both give 'That doesn't look like an email address...' (empty gets the wrong message); valid input shows the confirmation with an undo link that restores the form; it persists across reload. The success state itself is fake, and pause gives no paused label.
evidence.copy: Warm and specific in places ('It works the day you unbox it and keeps working if we go out of business.', 'Full light, a warm white. Nothing rang.'), consistent dial vocabulary. But it is long and wanders into invented specifics (chime, press-and-hold, auto-refund), and 'Light sleepers may begin to stir' / 'This is the point where most of us give up on sleep' edge toward the effect claims the brief disowns.
evidence.first_screen: 1440: metaphor headline, specific lede, auto-playing scene with clock readout, and 'Reserve a place' with the deposit note all in view: strong. 390: headline and the playing artifact are visible but no action and no deposit line until y=1028, and the H1 alone does not name the sunrise mechanism.

problems: The reserve form reports 'Your place is held. We've noted <email>. You'll get one email when the $20 deposit opens' although nothing is sent anywhere (empty HOLD_ENDPOINT, localStorage only), and the page never says so before the visitor submits.

Invented facts and commitments the brief does not support: 'autumn 2027', a Charlotte prototype used 'every morning since spring', automatic refunds on a season's slip, an optional chime, press-to-toggle reading mode.
At 390 the primary action and deposit note sit below the first screen (y=1028), header links are 25px tall with no menu, and they wrap awkwardly at 320.

hard_fail_flags.evidence: The primary action 'Reserve a place' (hero, 1440) leads to the #reserve form whose only control is 'Hold my place'. Submitting a valid email shows 'Your place is held. We've noted test@example.com. You'll get one email when the $20 deposit opens, and another whenever the plan changes.' No request is made: in the inline script HOLD_ENDPOINT = '' so the fetch branch is skipped and the address is only written to localStorage('morrow.held'). Before submitting, the page says 'Leave your email and we'll hold your place in line' and 'you can hold a place with your email today', i.e. it does not disclose that nothing is sent. This is success reported for something that did not happen, without saying so before the visitor acted.
hard_fail_flags.steps: Open packets/P002/B/index.html from disk at 1440x900. Click 'Reserve a place'. Type test@example.com in 'Your email' and click 'Hold my place'. Observe the 'Your place is held.' box. Check the network panel (no request) and the script near 'var HOLD_ENDPOINT = '';' and localStorage key 'morrow.held'.

reason: A puts a labelled, operable sunrise next to a specific promise and an action whose real result ('opens an email to us, take nothing today') is stated before the click, with careful states and a recomposed phone layout. B has the more beautiful scene and ramp section, but its reservation shows a confirmation for a hold that never leaves the browser, it invents dates and facts the brief disowns, and its phone first screen loses the action. A B whose form honestly said it was not sent yet, with the CTA moved above the scene at 390, would be close to or ahead of A on design alone.
